chunks: He said, 'Yes, and indeed you will be among the honoured (al-Muqarrabun).'
ai.seo_question: Who are the Muqarrabun in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tawassul* and the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt, as the 'Muqarrabun' include the Prophets, Imams, and righteous servants who draw near to Allah through divine grace. The affirmation 'Indeed, you are among the Muqarrabun' underscores the ultimate spiritual elevation of the faithful, distinguishing them from the general inhabitants of Paradise by their proximity to the Divine Presence.
